judgment: seven days, and the return comes.
It is good to set out.
image: Thunder in the earth: Coming Back.
So the early kings, at the turning day, closed the passes.
and the ruler did not go round the regions.
lines: Coming back again and again: danger.
Coming back, lost: misfortune, disaster on disaster.
Sending out the army ends in great defeat,
For ten years, unable to march.

notes.name_en: 復 is the turn back along the road; 'Coming Back', not Wilhelm's 'Return (The Turning Point)'.
notes.image: 至日 the solstice 'turning day'; passes closed, rest enforced.
notes.L6: 災眚 disaster from outside and harm from within, rendered 'disaster on disaster'.
